title: A typed letter
note: Typed letters have the words and the signature, with "Typed" provenance, and no player or recording line.
text: Aa Monday, October 26, 2026 Bath time. You splash with your whole body, both hands, both feet, and then you check that I saw. From Mama Typed Make private Delete
